Forest Dome Mini Eco-Friendly Décor – Premium 50ml Glass Dome with Preserved Moss & Flowers

The Forest Dome mini Eco-Friendly décor piece is crafted for people who appreciate sustainable, natural, and minimalist design. Featuring a 50ml glass dome paired with a sturdy 70mm cork base, this elegant mini display brings nature indoors without the need for any upkeep. Its compact 3″ dia x 3.4″ height makes it the perfect addition to office desks, reception counters, workstations, study tables, and small home spaces. Designed with preserved moss and flowers, this eco-forward accessory adds a calming, forest-inspired aesthetic while remaining zero maintenance.

Each Forest Dome mini Eco-Friendly table décor jar is handmade using premium preserved botanicals that retain their vibrant colors and natural textures for years. Because the arrangement is sealed inside a high-quality 50ml glass dome, the contents stay protected from dust, moisture, and sunlight. The 70mm cork base is fully biodegradable and provides a rustic, earthy charm that enhances the natural feel of the arrangement. This makes the dome an excellent choice for eco-friendly gifts, sustainable corporate gifting, employee welcome kits, festive hampers, desk décor accessories, table décor and wellness-inspired workspace decorations.

The use of preserved moss and flowers ensures long-lasting beauty without watering, trimming, or sunlight exposure. This zero maintenance table décor product is ideal for busy professionals, minimalist design lovers, and companies looking for environmentally conscious gifting solutions. With its compact 3″ dia x 3.4″ height, it fits effortlessly into small spaces while still standing out as a beautiful decorative accent.

Whether you’re decorating a modern office or creating a personalized work desk setup, the Forest Dome mini Eco-Friendly dome adds a touch of tranquility and sophistication. Unlike living terrariums, this preserved arrangement requires no care, making it perfect for gifting employees, clients, coworkers, or friends. It also serves as a thoughtful accessory for nature-based themes, meditation corners, bookshelf styling, and eco-conscious lifestyle setups.

Key Features

  • Premium Forest Dome mini Eco-Friendly design ideal for workspaces and gifting
  • Durable 50ml glass dome protects contents and enhances visibility
  • Natural preserved moss and flowers with long-lasting freshness
  • Eco-safe 70mm cork base with earthy, sustainable aesthetics
  • Compact size: 3″ dia x 3.4″ height for perfect desk placement
  • Completely zero maintenance – no watering or sunlight needed
  • Excellent for eco-friendly gifts, corporate gifting, table décor, and mini terrarium alternatives
  • Handcrafted design using sustainable and biodegradable materials
  • Long-lasting preserved botanicals with vibrant, natural appeal

Upgrade your workspace or enrich your gifting experiences with the Forest Dome mini Eco-Friendly table décor dome. Its unique combination of a 50ml glass dome, elegant preserved moss and flowers, classic 70mm cork base, and compact 3″ dia x 3.4″ height makes it a timeless, stylish, and nature-inspired table décor piece for any setting.
